title: Wall-clock latency assertions are a resource-contention flake vector
evidence: acceptance/provided_data_test.go:57,66 assert ConfirmAnsweredWithin("2s"/"5s") inline with functional specs; under a loaded CI box this can produce a false red (ATDD review lesson 306)
suggestion: Move NFR timing checks to a separate tagged suite in a controlled env, or give the threshold real headroom and re-measure on near-miss rather than hard-fail

title: Exact-count assertions couple provided-data specs to a dataset snapshot
evidence: acceptance/provided_data_test.go:124 ConfirmTotal(827) and sibling exact counts depend on the Kaggle snapshot; a data refresh would break the spec even though behaviour is unchanged
suggestion: Pin the data/kaggle snapshot alongside the tests (checksum) and prefer ConfirmFoundAtLeast ranges where the exact number is not the behaviour under test

title: Some sample-question confirmations check an answer exists, not the right answer
evidence: acceptance/provided_data_test.go:109,118,133 use ConfirmSomeTeamRankedFirst()/ConfirmFoundAtLeast(1); a ranking bug could pass these smoke-level checks (ATDD review lesson 203)
suggestion: Tighten to ConfirmRankedFirst("team: ...") where a historically-known answer exists; comment the genuinely open-ended ones as deliberate coverage checks

title: Line coverage is 38.4% because acceptance tests drive the binary as a subprocess
evidence: scores.json test_coverage=0.384 while defect_rate=1.0 (build+tests pass); acceptance/main_test.go builds and runs the server out-of-process so go test -cover cannot instrument it. Not a defect — an artifact of black-box ATDD
suggestion: If coverage is a reported metric, consider an in-process coverage build (GOCOVERDIR) for the subprocess, or accept that black-box coverage understates behavioural testing

title: Scope well beyond the spec: 20 MCP tools and honest findings log
evidence: internal/app/tools.go registers 20 tools (derbies, brackets, season comparison, club profiles); docs/atdd-findings.md records real data limitations e.g. incomplete 2023 season -> no champion named
suggestion: None — surfaced as positive signal for cross-run comparison
